I’m reporting a critical crash issue related to GamePanelHUD when used with SPT 4.0.11 (EFT 0.16.9.0.40087).

Environment

Issue Summary

GamePanelHUD causes repeated NullReferenceExceptions during startup and can lead to CTD (Crash to Desktop).

The crash appears to be caused by missing or incompatible AssetBundle files referenced by GamePanelHUD and KmyTarkovApi.

Error Pattern (from LogOutput.log)

Unable to open archive file: C:/Games/SPT/BepInEx/plugins/kmyuhkyuk-GamePanelHUD/bundles/gamepanelcompasshud.bundle

NullReferenceException at: KmyTarkovConfiguration.Models.EFTConfigurationModel.LoadConfiguration() Behavior

Errors occur during plugin initialization

AssetBundles cannot be found or read

Conclusion

The issue does not appear to be a mod conflict, but rather:

AssetBundles missing or incompatible with EFT 0.16

Lack of null-checks / fallback handling in HUDCoreModel.LoadHUD()

Suggestion

Verify AssetBundle compatibility with EFT 0.16

Add defensive null checks before LoadHUD()

Consider disabling HUD modules gracefully if bundles fail to load
